studies.title: Cappadocia
studies.caption: Soft volcanic rock has weathered into cones, ridges and capped stone pillars.
studies.prompt: Eye-level view into Cappadocia valley of pale volcanic tuff cones and capped fairy chimneys, deeply eroded gullies, occasional small rock-cut opening subordinate to geology. No tourist balloons, hotels, exotic fantasy towers or implausible natural arches.
